import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_data = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_data.pivot(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot = survival_pivot.reindex(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#FF6B6B', '#95E1D3'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Survival count by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival = embark_survival.loc[embark_survival.index.dropna()]
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, 
                     color=['#FF6B6B', '#95E1D3'], width=0.6)
ax3.set_title('Passenger Count by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.legend(['Did not survive', 'Survived'], loc='upper right')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Fare distribution by class with survival overlay
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for pclass, class_name in zip([1, 2, 3], ['First', 'Second', 'Third']):
    class_data = df[df['pclass'] == pclass]
    survived_fare = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 1]['fare'].dropna()
    died_fare = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 0]['fare'].dropna()
    
    # Create violin plots for each class
    parts = ax4.violinplot([survived_fare], positions=[pclass * 2 - 0.4], 
                           widths=0.6, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
    for pc in parts['bodies']:
        pc.set_facecolor('#95E1D3')
        pc.set_alpha(0.6)
    
    parts = ax4.violinplot([died_fare], positions=[pclass * 2 + 0.4], 
                           widths=0.6, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
    for pc in parts['bodies']:
        pc.set_facecolor('#FF6B6B')
        pc.set_alpha(0.6)

ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticks([2, 4, 6])
ax4.set_xticklabels(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Create custom legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#95E1D3', alpha=0.6, label='Survived'),
                   Patch(facecolor='#FF6B6B', alpha=0.6, label='Did not survive')]
ax4.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right')
ax4.set_ylim(0, 300)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
